# The reviewed list of string-valued key paths of the scrubbed Telegram fixtures (TG-2 fix J12).
# One path per line: object keys joined with `/`, `[]` for a list item (`levels/[]/@type`). A string
# value at a path that is not here fails `tests/fixture.rs` (`the_fixture_is_scrubbed`) and the scrub
# script (`scripts/tg-fixture-scrub.py`): a new kind of text (a username, a bio, a link, an e-mail
# pattern, a hint) has to be looked at by a person before it is added. The values at these paths
# are the synthetic ones, so the list may name them. Lines starting with `#` are comments.

# TG-3 C5..C6 (receive-kinds.jsonl, receive-service.jsonl, receive-entities.jsonl, synthetic; every path READ by the

# order), `message/reply_to`, `scheduling_state` and `self_destruct_type` kinds, `scope/@type` (a notification scope),
# `title` (a chat title: `Group <n>`, `Channel <n>` or a synthetic person), `user/usernames/*` (a USERNAME, like the
# `supergroup/usernames/*` rows above: only `synthetic_<n>`, TF17), and the text entities (`@type`, a code block's
# `language`, a custom emoji id, and `type/url`: a LINK, only a host on example.org or example.invalid, TF17).
